description.text: An expansion pack of the Pokémon Card Game series, released on 10 March 2006 after an early start at Pokémon Centers on 3 March. It is set on islands far out at sea, home to δ Delta Species Pokémon and Pokémon ex, and Charizard appears as a Lightning-type Delta Species. It reprints Double Rainbow Energy, and its Star cards are Celebi and Alakazam. The cards are numbered to 75. In English it became EX Crystal Guardians in July 2006.
